name: Generate images of tissue type masks
summary: Generates PNGs of gray matter, white matter, CSF and GM/WM interface masks from an MRtrix3 five-tissue-type image, optionally outlined on a T1, for QA of tissue segmentation.
description: Splits the 5TT image into GM, WM and CSF volumes with mrconvert, binarizes them with fslmaths, derives the GM/WM interface with 5ttgen's 5tt2gmwmi, and renders each with FSL slicer (outlined on the T1 when one is given). Use it to check a 5TT segmentation before anatomically constrained tractography.

inputs.description: The path to the mask datatype containing the 5 tissue probability image from Tissue-type segmentation
inputs.requirements: MRtrix3 5TT format: volume 0 GM, 2 WM, 3 CSF.

inputs.description: If you include a T1, the output pngs will include an outline of the different tissue type masks overlaid on the T1 image
inputs.requirements: Must be on the same voxel grid as the 5TT image.

outputs.description: Directory with gm.png, wm.png, csf.png and gmwmi.png.
